This difference arises because expectiles incorporate the magnitude of the errors, leading to different optimal decisions based on the asymmetry of the loss function. The feature automatically deletes audio and summaries after a set period, and it lacks outward indicators of recording intent. Ultimately, the author concluded that the perceived benefits of ambient listening do not outweigh the ethical and practical concerns. The experience highlighted the need for clearer cultural norms regarding the use of such privacy-sensitive technology.

This report examines the balance between privacy and utility concerning always-listening artificial intelligence. The author tested Apple's Siri Recap feature over a two-week period and found that the resulting summaries frequently lacked useful personal context or humor despite built-in privacy safeguards. The feature automatically deletes audio and summaries after a defined duration and does not provide outward indications of recording intent. The experience indicated that the perceived advantages of ambient listening do not supersede the ethical and practical concerns raised by the technology. This situation suggests a requirement for clearer societal norms regarding the deployment of privacy-sensitive listening technologies by the AI industry.

items.title: AI industry growth remains strong, but the pace is slowing
items.summary: AI industry growth is still strong but the pace is slowing, as evidenced by declining token prices and cooling spending. Token spending fell 6.3% from its peak two weeks prior, despite a 12% month-over-month rise in total spending. The price war among providers is leading to cheaper tokens, with OpenAI and Anthropic seeing average prices decrease. While usage volume is rising significantly, spending patterns show a slowdown, with a spending peak observed in October followed by declines. Overall, the market signals a need for more capable models or better workflow integration to sustain future growth.
